verdict.rationale: Convex schemas are defined as TypeScript code (convex/schema.ts) that lives in the repo, so they are inherently version-controlled, and the CLI pushes schema changes to dev/deployments (convex-docs-6/17). However, the evidence shows no dedicated migration system (no up/down scripts, versioning, rollback) and no explicit CI/deploy command—only dev-watch and utility commands like import/insights/run are documented.
